menu_l_global_value_pdthdrip: This A PAYDAY: THE HEIST Item!
bm_suit_pdthsuit_desc: Some people say that the past is best left behind. Those people are idiots! Without properly commemorating the old days, you're doomed to repeat forgotten mistakes. Chasing Matt down the same street twice, for instance.
bm_gloves_pdthglv_desc: Cheap and disposable, perfect for covering up the perfect crime.
bm_suit_var_pdthsuit_default_desc: When Bain first recruited him, Dallas was just a part of the team like any other. He grew into his leadership rope, which is perhaps what makes him the best for the position.
bm_suit_var_pdthsuit_wolf_desc: Wolf truly has found his calling long, long ago. His expertise is still mostly handling the equipment, his preferred threads are the same, and he still hasn't found his marbles.
bm_suit_var_pdthsuit_hoxton_desc: The role of a sharpshooter should be reserved for the man with patience and the coolest head. Hoxton represents this perfectly, except not at all.
bm_suit_var_pdthsuit_chains_desc: Once upon a time, Chains was the crew's trusted man for all things medical. Now, he has an incredibly low tolerance for needles. He is quite the changed man.
bm_suit_var_pdthsuit_traitor_desc: On top of being not the least bit trustworthy, Matt is also extremely foolish. How he was spared the first time is anyone's guess.
